embeds.title: Agg/Def Results
embeds.description:
Attack: **1.2** second(s)
Recharge: **1.7** second(s)
Init Skill: **300**

You must set your AGG bar at **73% (6)** to wield your weapon at **1/1**.
(Agg/def-Slider should read **45**).

**Init needed for max speed at**
Full Agg (100%): **135** inits
Neutral (87.5%): **210** inits
Full Def (0%): **1170** inits

```
1170 DEF ||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||│||||||||||||| AGG 135
                                         You: 300
```
Note that at the neutral position (87.5%), your attack and recharge time will match that of the weapon you are using.

Based upon a RINGBOT module made by NoGoal(RK2)
Modified for Budabot by Healnjoo and Nadyita
